title: An Interpretable CF-RL-TOPSIS Fusion Model for Skills-Aware Talent Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2605.24155v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Effective skills-aware talent recommendation must balance behavioral transition patterns, trajectory-sensitive adaptation, and inspectable occupation-level criteria. Evidence from public benchmarks on how these signals interact, however, remains limited. This study proposes CF-RL-TOPSIS, an interpretable late-fusion model that integrates a transition-aware collaborative branch, a compact reinforcement-style occupation-family bandit, and an entropy-weighted TOPSIS branch constructed from six semantic proxies; the validation-selected fusion coefficients remain auditable. The model is evaluated on two frozen public ICT talent-history benchmarks, JobHop and Karrierewege, using repeated chronological top-5 ranking and paired Wilcoxon tests. On JobHop the full hybrid attains NDCG@5 = 0.3040 +/- 0.0073 and significantly surpasses repeat-last, item Markov, transition-aware collaborative filtering, the CF+TOPSIS hybrid, GRU4Rec, and SAS

translated_title: 面向技能感知人才推荐的可解释CF-RL-TOPSIS融合模型
translated_abstract: 有效的技能感知人才推荐必须平衡行为转换模式、轨迹敏感的适应性以及可审查的职业层级标准。然而，关于这些信号如何相互作用的公开基准证据仍然有限。本研究提出CF-RL-TOPSIS，这是一种可解释的后期融合模型，它集成了一个转换感知的协同过滤分支、一个紧凑的强化学习式职业族老虎机分支，以及一个由六个语义代理指标构建的熵权TOPSIS分支；经验证筛选的融合系数保持可审计性。该模型在两个冻结的公开ICT人才历史基准数据集JobHop和Karrierewege上进行评估，采用重复的时间顺序top-5排名和配对Wilcoxon检验。在JobHop数据集上，完整的混合模型达到NDCG@5 = 0.3040 ± 0.0073，并显著超越了repeat-last、item Markov、转换感知协同过滤、CF+TOPSIS混合模型、GRU4Rec和SAS等基线方法。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种可解释的CF-RL-TOPSIS融合模型，通过整合协同过滤、强化学习和熵权TOPSIS三种方法进行技能感知的人才推荐，在两个公开ICT人才数据集上显著优于现有基准方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an interpretable CF-RL-TOPSIS fusion model that integrates collaborative filtering, reinforcement learning, and entropy-weighted TOPSIS for skills-aware talent recommendation, significantly outperforming existing baselines on two public ICT talent benchmarks.
